class.name: WebGridContainer
class.brief_description: A container that arranges its children using the browser's CSS Grid layout model.
class.description: [WebGridContainer] lays out its child controls in a grid of [member row_count] by [member column_count] cells. Children are placed in document order using row-major automatic placement; rows are added implicitly when there are more children than logical cells. Each row and column track is sized with a unit matching CSS: [constant UNIT_AUTO] (content based), [constant UNIT_PX] (pixels), [constant UNIT_PERCENT] (percentage of the container size on that axis) and [constant UNIT_FR] (a fraction of the leftover space). Track sizes are set with [method set_column_track_unit]/[method set_column_track_value] and the row equivalents. Children always flow automatically through the grid's logical cells. Merge topology is stored only in [member merged_cell_rects], so it remains unchanged when children are added, removed, reordered, or moved. [member justify_items]/[member align_items] set the default alignment of every child within its area, and can be overridden per child with [method set_child_justify_self]/[method set_child_align_self]. [member justify_content]/[member align_content] distribute leftover space between and around the tracks. [member column_gap]/[member row_gap] add gutters between tracks. The grid lines can be dragged and cells can be selected and merged (the editor offers this on the 2D canvas; setting [member runtime_interactive] enables the same behavior at runtime). All edit/runtime interaction is exposed as methods ([method find_line_at], [method begin_line_drag], [method select_cell], [method merge_selected_cells], etc.) so it can be scripted and tested. All property defaults match the CSS initial values. Note that, unlike a CSS box, a Godot [Control] cannot be smaller than its content's minimum size, so the container grows to fit its children instead of letting them overflow a fixed size.

method.name: begin_cell_drag
method.description: Starts a cell-selection drag anchored at [param cell] (column in [code]x[/code], row in [code]y[/code]). Follow with [method update_cell_drag] and [method end_cell_drag].

method.name: begin_line_drag
method.description: Starts dragging the grid line between track [param boundary] and [param boundary] + 1 (a column boundary when [param is_columns] is [code]true[/code], otherwise a row boundary). When [param ctrl] is [code]true[/code] the whole axis is scaled proportionally. Follow with [method update_line_drag] and [method end_line_drag].

method.name: can_merge_selected_cells
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the current selection is inside the grid, covers more than one cell, and grid editing is enabled. Connect [signal merge_available_changed] to update a custom Merge button without polling.

method.name: can_unmerge_selected_cells
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the current selection overlaps an effective merged region and grid editing is enabled. Connect [signal unmerge_available_changed] to update a custom Unmerge button without polling.

method.name: cell_at
method.description: Returns the cell (column in [code]x[/code], row in [code]y[/code]) at [param local_position] (in the container's local coordinates), or [code](-1, -1)[/code] if the point is not over a cell.

method.name: clear_cell_selection
method.description: Clears the current cell selection and emits [signal cells_selected] with an empty rectangle.

method.name: end_cell_drag
method.description: Ends a cell-selection drag started with [method begin_cell_drag]. The selection itself is kept.

method.name: end_line_drag
method.description: Ends a grid-line drag started with [method begin_line_drag].

method.name: export_css
method.description: Returns the current grid as a CSS string: a [code]grid[/code] rule with [code]grid-template-rows[/code], [code]grid-template-columns[/code] and [code]gap[/code], followed by rules for children with non-default [code]justify-self[/code] or [code]align-self[/code]. Visual styling (background, border, shadow) is handled by the [code]panel[/code] Theme StyleBox and is not part of the exported CSS. See [method import_css] for the inverse.

method.name: find_line_at
method.description: Hit-tests a draggable grid line near [param local_position] (local coordinates), within [param radius] pixels. The radius is shrunk automatically for narrow tracks so two close lines never overlap their hit zones. A boundary that runs through the interior of a merged cell is not hit-testable there (it has no visible line and cannot be dragged). Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]axis[/code] ([code]"column"[/code], [code]"row"[/code] or [code]""[/code]) and [code]index[/code] (the boundary index, or [code]-1[/code] if no line was hit).

method.name: get_axis_available
method.description: Returns the container's size along the requested axis (width when [param is_columns] is [code]true[/code], otherwise height).

method.name: get_child_align_self
method.description: Returns the [code]align-self[/code] override of the child at [param index] (in sortable-child order).

method.name: get_child_justify_self
method.description: Returns the [code]justify-self[/code] override of the child at [param index] (in sortable-child order).

method.name: get_child_resolved_grid_rect
method.description: Returns the final zero-based grid area occupied by the child at [param index] after merge-aware auto-placement. A child placed in a merged logical cell occupies the complete merged region.

method.name: get_column_track_unit
method.description: Returns the sizing unit of column track [param index].

method.name: get_column_track_value
method.description: Returns the size value of column track [param index] (interpreted according to its unit).

method.name: get_effective_column_count
method.description: Returns the number of columns actually used, including implicit columns required by [member merged_cell_rects] (always at least [member column_count]).

method.name: get_effective_row_count
method.description: Returns the number of rows actually used after auto-placement, including implicit rows created when there are more children than explicit cells (always at least [member row_count]).

method.name: get_gap_rects
method.description: Returns the gap regions (the spacing between tracks) as an [Array] of [Rect2] in local container coordinates, like the browser DevTools grid-gap overlay. A gap strip that falls inside a merged cell is omitted (the merged area reads as one block). Returns an empty array when both [member column_gap] and [member row_gap] are [code]0[/code]. Shared by the runtime overlay and the canvas editor gizmo.

method.name: get_grid_line_segments
method.description: Returns the grid-line segments to draw, in local container coordinates, as an [Array] of [PackedVector2Array] (each holding a [code]start[/code] and [code]end[/code] point). Lines are continuous across gaps (one segment per run of cells, so a gap never breaks a line) and are split where they would cross a merged cell's interior, so they line up exactly with the laid-out cells. The built-in overlay draws its cell outlines from the cell rects instead, so these segments are for headless tests and for custom overlays that want the raw lines.

method.name: get_merged_cell_rects
method.description: Returns the authoritative grid-owned merged regions stored by [member merged_cell_rects].

method.name: get_merged_rects
method.description: Returns the merged cell areas as an [Array] of [Rect2i] ([code]position[/code] = top-left cell, [code]size[/code] = column/row span). This is the authoritative [member merged_cell_rects] topology used by layout, the editor, and the runtime overlay. Child spans are not included.

method.name: get_resolved_column_offsets
method.description: Returns the laid-out start offset of every column track (including implicit ones) for the current container size.

method.name: get_resolved_column_sizes
method.description: Returns the laid-out size of every column track (including implicit ones) for the current container size.

method.name: get_resolved_row_offsets
method.description: Returns the laid-out start offset of every row track (including implicit ones) for the current container size.

method.name: get_resolved_row_sizes
method.description: Returns the laid-out size of every row track (including implicit ones) for the current container size.

method.name: get_row_track_unit
method.description: Returns the sizing unit of row track [param index].

method.name: get_row_track_value
method.description: Returns the size value of row track [param index] (interpreted according to its unit).

method.name: get_runtime_overlay_control
method.description: Returns the lazily created runtime overlay root, or [code]null[/code] when the overlay is disabled. A host that supplied [method set_runtime_overlay_parent] may reorder this control within that parent to match its logical paint order.

method.name: get_runtime_overlay_parent
method.description: Returns the external runtime overlay parent assigned with [method set_runtime_overlay_parent], or [code]null[/code] when the built-in top-level overlay is used.

method.name: get_selection_rect
method.description: Returns the currently selected cell range ([code]position[/code] = top-left cell, [code]size[/code] = number of columns/rows), or an empty rectangle if there is no selection.

method.name: has_cell_selection
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a cell range is currently selected.

method.name: import_css
method.description: Updates the grid from a CSS string. The [code]grid[/code] rule sets [code]grid-template-rows[/code] / [code]grid-template-columns[/code] (each token is one track: [code]auto[/code], [code]<n>px[/code], [code]<n>%[/code] or [code]<n>fr[/code]) and [code]gap[/code] / [code]row-gap[/code] / [code]column-gap[/code]. Any other rule is matched to a child by node name and may set [code]justify-self[/code] and [code]align-self[/code]. Box-model properties are ignored; use the [code]panel[/code] Theme StyleBox for visual styling instead. Inverse of [method export_css].

method.name: is_grid_editable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] unless [member draw_grid] is [constant DRAW_GRID_NEVER]. When it is [code]false[/code] the node has no grid overlay and no grid editing at all: lines cannot be dragged, cells cannot be selected, and merging / unmerging is unavailable, so the node behaves like any other container.

method.name: is_line_dragging
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a grid-line drag is in progress.

method.name: merge_selected_cells
method.description: Stores the current multi-cell selection in the grid's merge topology without changing child alignment. Children are reflowed through the resulting logical cells, and an occupant automatically fills the complete merged region. The merge remains unchanged when children are added, removed, reordered, or moved. Clears the selection and emits [signal cells_merged]. Returns the current occupant's index, [code]-2[/code] for a successful merge without an occupant, or [code]-1[/code] when the selection is invalid. A single-cell selection is always rejected.

method.name: select_cell
method.description: Selects [param cell]. When [param shift] is [code]true[/code] and a selection already exists, the selection is extended to the rectangle spanning from the anchor to [param cell] (like Excel's shift+click). Emits [signal cells_selected].

method.name: set_child_align_self
method.description: Sets the [code]align-self[/code] override of the child at [param index].

method.name: set_child_justify_self
method.description: Sets the [code]justify-self[/code] override of the child at [param index].

method.name: set_column_track_unit
method.description: Sets the sizing unit of column track [param index].

method.name: set_column_track_value
method.description: Sets the size value of column track [param index] (interpreted according to its unit).

method.name: set_merged_cell_rects
method.description: Sets the serialized grid-owned merge regions. Invalid and single-cell rectangles are discarded. Intersecting rectangles are normalized into non-overlapping bounding regions.

method.name: set_row_track_unit
method.description: Sets the sizing unit of row track [param index].

method.name: set_row_track_value
method.description: Sets the size value of row track [param index] (interpreted according to its unit).

method.name: set_runtime_overlay_parent
method.description: Parents the runtime interaction overlay below [param parent] instead of making it a canvas-global top-level control. This is intended for editors whose logical children are flat canvas siblings: place the control returned by [method get_runtime_overlay_control] immediately after the grid's logical subtree so later foreground nodes retain their paint and input order. Pass [code]null[/code] to restore the built-in top-level behavior.

method.name: unmerge_selected_cells
method.description: Removes every logical merged region overlapped by the current selection without changing child alignment. Returns the number of logical regions removed and emits [signal cells_unmerged] once per removed region.

method.name: update_cell_drag
method.description: Extends the in-progress cell-selection drag to [param cell]. Does nothing if no drag is active. Emits [signal cells_selected].

method.name: update_line_drag
method.description: Moves the dragged grid line so its boundary follows [param local_position] (local coordinates). The resolved layout updates immediately. Dragging a boundary trades size only between its two adjacent tracks; an [constant UNIT_FR][code]/[/code][constant UNIT_FR] boundary trades in fraction units so the other [code]fr[/code] tracks are unaffected, while a fixed[code]/[/code][code]fr[/code] boundary resizes the fixed side and lets the [code]fr[/code] track absorb the rest.

members.member: Distributes leftover vertical space between and around the row tracks. Equivalent to the CSS [code]align-content[/code] property. The default [constant CONTENT_STRETCH] matches the CSS initial value [code]normal[/code].
Default vertical alignment of each child within its area. Equivalent to the CSS [code]align-items[/code] property. Overridden per child by [method set_child_align_self].
The number of explicit column tracks. Equivalent to the number of tracks in CSS [code]grid-template-columns[/code].
The gutter, in pixels, between column tracks. Equivalent to the CSS [code]column-gap[/code] property.

When the browser-DevTools-style overlay (hatched cells and gap strips, merged blocks, the cell selection and the grid frame) is drawn over the container, and whether the grid can be edited on the canvas at all. See [constant DRAW_GRID_SELECTED], [constant DRAW_GRID_ALWAYS] and [constant DRAW_GRID_NEVER]. In a running scene the overlay additionally requires [member runtime_interactive].

Distributes leftover horizontal space between and around the column tracks. Equivalent to the CSS [code]justify-content[/code] property. The default [constant CONTENT_STRETCH] matches the CSS initial value [code]normal[/code].
Default horizontal alignment of each child within its area. Equivalent to the CSS [code]justify-items[/code] property. Overridden per child by [method set_child_justify_self].
The authoritative serialized merge topology in zero-based cell coordinates. Layout, drawing, hit-testing, selection snapping, merge and unmerge all use these regions independently of child nodes.
The number of explicit row tracks. Equivalent to the number of tracks in CSS [code]grid-template-rows[/code]. Extra children create implicit rows beyond this count.
The gutter, in pixels, between row tracks. Equivalent to the CSS [code]row-gap[/code] property.

When [code]true[/code], the container handles mouse input at runtime to drag grid lines and select/merge cells, the same way the editor does at edit time. An internal overlay captures the input so the child controls are never selected instead of the grid.

When [code]true[/code] (and [member runtime_interactive] is enabled), a default [b]Merge[/b] button appears centered over the current multi-cell selection at runtime. Pressing it calls [method merge_selected_cells]. This button only appears in a running scene; in the editor, use the [b]Merge Cells[/b] button in the 2D canvas toolbar instead.

signal.name: grid_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the grid definition changes (track count, sizes, gaps, alignment, merge topology, or interaction state). Used by the editor to keep the inspector and canvas in sync.

signal.name: cells_selected
signal.description: Emitted when the cell selection changes. [param rect] is the selected range ([code]position[/code] = top-left cell, [code]size[/code] = columns/rows), or empty when the selection was cleared.

signal.name: cells_merged
signal.description: Emitted by [method merge_selected_cells] after a merge. [param child_index] is the child occupying the merged logical cell at that moment, or [code]-1[/code] when it is empty; [param rect] is the merged cell range. Child alignment is unchanged.

signal.name: cells_unmerged
signal.description: Emitted by [method unmerge_selected_cells] for each removed logical region. [param child_index] is the child that occupied the region immediately before unmerging, or [code]-1[/code] when it was empty. Child alignment is unchanged.

signal.name: merge_available_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method can_merge_selected_cells] changes. Custom Merge buttons can bind their disabled state to [code]not available[/code].

signal.name: merged_cells_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the grid-owned merge topology changes through merging, unmerging, or [member merged_cell_rects].

signal.name: unmerge_available_changed
signal.description: Emitted when [method can_unmerge_selected_cells] changes. Custom Unmerge buttons can bind their disabled state to [code]not available[/code].

constants.constant: Draw the grid overlay only while this node is selected in the editor. This is the default.
Always draw the grid overlay, even while something else is selected.
Never draw the grid overlay, and turn off every grid interaction: no line dragging, no cell selection, and no merging or unmerging. The node then behaves like any other container on the canvas.
Content-based track sizing (CSS [code]auto[/code]). The default unit.
Fixed size in pixels (CSS [code]<length>[/code]).
Percentage of the container's size on the track's axis (CSS [code]<percentage>[/code]).
A fraction of the leftover space (CSS [code]<flex>[/code]/[code]fr[/code]).
Stretch each child to fill its area on the axis (CSS [code]stretch[/code]).
Align each child to the start of its area (CSS [code]start[/code]).
Align each child to the end of its area (CSS [code]end[/code]).
Center each child within its area (CSS [code]center[/code]).
Use the container's [member justify_items]/[member align_items] value (CSS [code]auto[/code]).
Stretch this child to fill its area on the axis.
Align this child to the start of its area.
Align this child to the end of its area.
Center this child within its area.
Pack the tracks at the start of the container (CSS [code]start[/code]).
Pack the tracks at the end of the container (CSS [code]end[/code]).
Center the tracks within the container (CSS [code]center[/code]).
Grow the auto-sized tracks to fill the leftover space (CSS [code]stretch[/code]; also the initial [code]normal[/code] behavior).
Distribute leftover space evenly between the tracks (CSS [code]space-between[/code]).
Distribute leftover space evenly around the tracks (CSS [code]space-around[/code]).
Distribute leftover space so all gaps, including the edges, are equal (CSS [code]space-evenly[/code]).

theme_items.theme_item: Bottom padding in pixels. Shifts the bottom edge of the grid content area inward, like CSS [code]padding-bottom[/code]. Default is [code]0[/code].
Left padding in pixels. Shifts the left edge of the grid content area inward, like CSS [code]padding-left[/code]. Default is [code]0[/code].
Right padding in pixels. Shifts the right edge of the grid content area inward, like CSS [code]padding-right[/code]. Default is [code]0[/code].
Top padding in pixels. Shifts the top edge of the grid content area inward, like CSS [code]padding-top[/code]. Default is [code]0[/code].

Background and border style for the container, drawn over the full outer rect (including the padding area). Assign a [StyleBoxFlat] here via a [Theme] resource or a per-node [b]Theme Override[/b] in the Inspector to add a background colour, border, rounded corners, or a drop shadow. The [code]padding_*[/code] theme constants control the content inset independently of this StyleBox.
